title: Deep Scientific Reasoning under Physical Constraints: Structure-Aware Spectrum Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.34021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structured scientific spectra encode rich physical information while obeying hard constraints, such as conservation laws and characteristic spectral geometry. Accurate prediction of these spectra is central to materials discovery, yet existing methods often treat them as unconstrained sequences and therefore fail to enforce the underlying physical structure. Taking electronic density of states (eDOS) as the prototypical example, we introduce DeepSciReasoner, a general paradigm for predicting scientific spectra under physical constraints. The framework combines structure-aware spectrum decoding with constraint-preserving physical reasoning, allowing predictions to capture rich spectral structure while respecting the underlying physics. translated_title: 物理约束下的深度科学推理：结构感知的谱预测
translated_abstract: 结构化科学谱在编码丰富物理信息的同时，还遵循严格的物理约束，例如守恒定律和特征谱几何结构。对这些谱的准确预测是材料发现的核心，然而现有方法通常将其视为无约束的序列，因此无法强制满足底层的物理结构。以电子态密度（eDOS）为典型示例，我们提出了DeepSciReasoner，这是一个在物理约束下预测科学谱的通用范式。该框架将结构感知的谱解码与保持约束的物理推理相结合，使预测既能捕获丰富的谱结构，又能尊重底层物理规律。我们在电子态密度（eDOS）、声子态密度（phDOS）、X射线吸收近边结构（XANES）和拉曼光谱上对DeepSciReasoner进行了评估，它在保持物理一致性的同时，显著提高了预测精度。
tldr: DeepSciReasoner提出了一种物理约束下科学谱预测的通用范式，通过结构感知解码与保持约束的物理推理相结合，在eDOS、phDOS、XANES和拉曼光谱预测中显著提升精度并保持物理一致性。
en_tdlr: DeepSciReasoner introduces a general paradigm for predicting scientific spectra under physical constraints by combining structure-aware decoding with constraint-preserving physical reasoning, substantially improving prediction accuracy across eDOS, phDOS, XANES, and Raman spectra while maintaining physical consistency.
